_comment: SSOT for the always-report CI shape. Each key names a substantive gating workflow; its array is the SAME path-glob list used by that workflow's `push` trigger (paths:) and by scripts/check-ci-relevant.mjs to compute pull_request relevance. Keep this the ONLY place the list lives — the four workflow files and the relevance script both read from here, so the list can never silently diverge between push-trigger filtering and PR relevance computation. [rce-round3-proof-c]
_comment_scripts_verify_manifest_inputs: 2026-09-18: the three entries after fv-explainer.html are GATE INPUTS, not gate code. The suite runs manifest-derived generated-block gates (check-ask-agent-block, gen-webmcp-registrations --check, check-a11y-tree) whose INPUT is manifests/ + chaingraph/kernels/fixtures/ + chaingraph/_page-chrome.mjs. With those paths absent, PR #1942 (manifests + tool pages, merged 19:42:37Z) reported `Full preflight gate suite | skipped` and `scripts-verify / required | success` while staling the ask-agent block on five node pages; main's push side was equally blind, so the defect surfaced only when the next builder's preflight refused to push. A gate whose INPUT is manifests/ must not sit behind a filter that excludes manifests/.
